title: Make health reachable from the packaged entry
description: src/index.ts never imports src/health.ts, so getHealth and the build time commit injection are absent from dist/index.js and a consumer cannot reach GET /health from the package at all. The tsup define is therefore unreachable through the public surface. tests/build/artifact.test.ts bundles health.ts explicitly to prove injection works (commit equals git rev-parse short HEAD) and carries an it.todo for the entry level assertion. Resolve together with the listener ticket.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text: Covered by the implementation ticket 4ef82184 in the same session: tests/build/artifact.test.ts now imports built index.js and asserts getHealth() deep-equals {status ok, version 0.1.0, commit shortHead}, plus the declaration surface. Verified green in the same pnpm check run.
comments.author: agent
